selection_subtitle: BUILD A PARTY OF UP TO FOUR CHARACTERS
selection_intro: Travel a wounded land, face the creatures in its shadows, and decide what your party will become.
combat_intro: Each character gets one move: attack, guard, or switch rows. Enemies have a fixed hit chance; characters roll d100 to defend, adjusted by Strength or Agility. A sudden ambush gives enemies the first round; otherwise the party acts first. Melee attacks against the back row provoke the front row.
journey_intro: The trail winds toward a land people have nearly forgotten. Prepare supplies and wealth before pushing into the unknown.
supply_shortage: The party needs more supply to travel or make camp.
win_title: Your party reaches the far country.
win_summary: The road remembers every kindness and every trespass.
loss_title: Your journey ends before the horizon.
loss_summary: The wilds have claimed the last strength of the party.
battle_start_log: The party is ambushed by creatures on the road.
victory_log: The monsters are defeated. The party gains {wealth} wealth and {reputation} reputation.
camp_log: The party camps, spends {supply} supply, and recovers {health} health.
guard_log: {name} braces for the next enemy strike.
